observations: Photo 0 shows a black rectangular console with a vertical vent on the right side and a small label with '4K/0.9' visible on the top left corner.
Photo 1 shows the same console from a different angle, with two black controllers placed on top of it.
The console has a matte black finish and a slim, blocky design typical of PlayStation 4 models.
The controllers appear to be standard DualShock 4 style, with visible buttons and analog sticks.
The console is placed on a light-colored wooden surface, with a patterned black-and-white floor visible in the background.
No screen, ports, or other accessories are visible in either photo.
The watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI OLADAPO ROTIMI' is overlaid on both photos.
